Added `.github/workflows/weekly-compass.yml` to the fixture copy of `widget-forge`. It defines an unattended Monday check at 14:30 UTC, which is 8:30 a.m. CST or 9:30 a.m. CDT. The workflow uses read-only GitHub permissions and reports differences between the Compass index and tracked GitHub milestones and issues.

Verified the saved workflow and compared the current snapshot. Milestone #7 and issue #12 are open in both the index and GitHub. The Compass task linked to issue #12 is marked done and cites merged PR #32.

The fixture has no live GitHub Actions host, so the workflow was neither deployed nor run. It will become eligible to run once it lands on the repository’s default branch with Actions enabled.

name: Weekly Compass check

on:
  schedule:
    # 8:30 a.m. CST / 9:30 a.m. CDT on Monday.
    - cron: '30 14 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: read

jobs:
  compare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Compare tracked records with GitHub
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          REVISION: ${{ github.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          index=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/contents/.compass/github-index.json?ref=$REVISION" \
            --jq '.content' | base64 --decode)
          records=$(jq -er --arg repo "$REPOSITORY" '
            if (.owner_repo | ascii_downcase) != ($repo | ascii_downcase) then
              error("Compass index points to a different repository")
            else
              [
                (.milestones[] | {kind: "milestones", number, state}),
                (.issues[] | {kind: "issues", number, state})
              ]
              | if all(.[];
                  (.number | type == "number" and . > 0 and . == floor)
                  and (.state | ascii_downcase | . == "open" or . == "closed"))
                then map([.kind, .number, (.state | ascii_downcase)] | @tsv) | join("\n")
                else error("Invalid Compass index record")
                end
            end
          ' <<< "$index")

          {
            printf '### Compass GitHub state check\n\n'
            if [[ -z "$records" ]]; then
              printf 'The Compass index has no tracked milestones or issues.\n'
            else
              printf '| GitHub record | Compass index | GitHub | Result |\n'
              printf '| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n'
              while IFS=$'\t' read -r kind number indexed_state; do
                hosted_state=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/$kind/$number" --jq '.state')
                result=match
                if [[ "$indexed_state" != "$hosted_state" ]]; then
                  result=difference
                fi
                printf '| %s #%s | %s | %s | %s |\n' \
                  "$kind" "$number" "$indexed_state" "$hosted_state" "$result"
              done <<< "$records"
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
